dedupe_keys.name: supsi photovoltaic cell multispectral images and power loss tests

description: The Mendeley PV_EL_HDR_BW_Test_DB release pairs images of deliberately damaged polycrystalline photovoltaic cells with controlled power-output measurements and written damage descriptions. The producer describes 84 progressive damage conditions, each with electroluminescence, near-infrared black-and-white and visible HDR views. The public file inventory has 260 entries, including the expected 252 images plus accompanying material, under CC BY 4.0. These paired observations can test an image-based condition or power-loss component in PV simulations, but the damaged cells are laboratory specimens, not an operational solar fleet. One cell technology, induced soiling and mechanical damage, and controlled electrical measurements are limitations for estimating field degradation rates. A reviewer-assessed use is checking whether a damage classifier produces plausible relative power derating. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related PV energy model; no image-to-SAM derating conversion was tested. No image, table or code file was downloaded. Coverage is confined to the laboratory cells and induced damage states at SUPSI.
